description: This file contains test helpers and mocks for testing the 'schtasks' functionality within a larger codebase, using 'vitest' for mocking and import statements to include fixtures and functions for mocking external modules.

methods.name: execSchtasks
methods.description: Mocks the execution of the schtasks command, returning a predefined response or an empty result.

methods.name: inspectPortUsage
methods.description: Mocks inspecting port usage on a given port.

methods.description: Mocks killing a process tree identified by PID with optional grace period.
